command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# aarchbio images: spawn's task shell drops the image PATH, so export it explicitly.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: fasta2nexus.awk does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== FASTA -> NEXUS (the alignment is the one iqtree staged; not a second copy) =="
awk -f fasta2nexus.awk aln.fa > data.nex || { echo "FAIL: conversion"; exit 1; }
NTAX=$(awk '/^    [A-Za-z0-9]/{c++} END{print c+0}' data.nex)
NCHAR=$(awk '/dimensions/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /^nchar=/) {sub(/nchar=/,"",$i); sub(/;/,"",$i); print $i}}' data.nex)
echo "nexus_taxa\t$NTAX"
echo "nexus_sites\t$NCHAR"
test "$NTAX" = "114" || { echo "FAIL: $NTAX taxa, expected 114"; exit 1; }
test "$NCHAR" = "477" || { echo "FAIL: $NCHAR sites, expected 477"; exit 1; }

# The label sets must be identical, or the tree this produces cannot be compared with the
# ML recipes' trees on topology -- it would be comparing different leaves.
awk '/^>/{print substr($0,2)}' aln.fa | sort > fa.labels
awk '/^    [A-Za-z0-9]/{print $1}' data.nex | sort > nx.labels
cmp -s fa.labels nx.labels || { echo "FAIL: label sets differ between FASTA and NEXUS"; exit 1; }
echo "label_sets\tidentical (114)"

echo "== MCMC: LG+G4, the SAME model raxml-ng and iqtree used =="
cat > run.nex <<'EOF'
#NEXUS
begin mrbayes;
  set autoclose=yes nowarn=yes seed=20261011 swapseed=20261011 usebeagle=no;
  execute data.nex;
  lset rates=gamma ngammacat=4;
  prset aamodelpr=fixed(lg);
  mcmcp ngen=100000 samplefreq=100 nchains=4 nruns=2 printfreq=10000 diagnfreq=5000
        stoprule=yes stopval=0.01 file=mb;
  mcmc;
  sumt burnin=250 conformat=simple;
  sump burnin=250;
  quit;
end;
EOF
S=$(date +%s)
mb run.nex > mb.out 2>&1
RC=$?
E=$(date +%s)
echo "mcmc_wall_s\t$((E-S))"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: mb exited $RC"; tail -40 mb.out; exit 1; }

# The model must be the one claimed -- a silent fall back to Poisson would still produce
# a tree, and the cross-check with the ML recipes would then be a method difference.
grep -q 'Setting Aamodelpr to Fixed(LG)' mb.out || {
  echo "FAIL: the run did not use LG; the cross-check would not be like-with-like"
  grep -i aamodelpr mb.out | head; exit 1; }
echo "model\tLG+G4 (Fixed(LG), 4 gamma categories)"
grep -q 'Setting number of rate categories to 4' mb.out && echo "gamma_categories\t4"

grep -q 'Analysis completed in' mb.out || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo "completion\tAnalysis completed (sentinel present)"

echo "== exact sample arithmetic: ngen/samplefreq + 1 per run =="
for n in 1 2; do
  ROWS=$(grep -vc '^\[ID' "mb.run$n.p")
  echo "p_rows_run$n\t$ROWS"
  test "$ROWS" = "1002" || { echo "FAIL: run$n has $ROWS .p lines, expected 1002 (header + 1001 samples)"; exit 1; }
  T=$(grep -c '^   tree gen' "mb.run$n.t")
  echo "t_trees_run$n\t$T"
  test "$T" = "1001" || { echo "FAIL: run$n has $T sampled trees, expected 1001"; exit 1; }
done

echo "== conservation: topology posterior probabilities sum to 1 =="
LASTP=$(grep -o 'P = [0-9.]*' mb.trprobs | tail -1 | awk '{print $3}')
echo "trprobs_cumulative_P\t$LASTP"
test "$LASTP" = "1.000" || { echo "FAIL: cumulative topology probability is $LASTP, not 1.000"; exit 1; }
NTOPO=$(grep -c '^   tree tree_' mb.trprobs)
echo "distinct_topologies\t$NTOPO"

echo "== consensus -> Newick, with the label set asserted =="
awk -f nexus2newick.awk mb.con.tre > mb.consensus.nwk || { echo "FAIL: newick conversion"; exit 1; }
tr ',()' '\n\n\n' < mb.consensus.nwk | sed 's/:.*//' | grep -E '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$' | sort -u > nwk.labels
NL=$(grep -c . nwk.labels)
echo "newick_labels\t$NL"
cmp -s fa.labels nwk.labels || {
  echo "FAIL: the Newick consensus labels are not the alignment's 114 labels"
  diff fa.labels nwk.labels | head; exit 1; }
echo "newick_label_sets\tidentical to the alignment"

echo "== convergence, REPORTED not asserted =="
ASDSF=$(grep -o 'Average standard deviation of split frequencies: [0-9.]*' mb.out | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}')
echo "asdsf\t$ASDSF"
grep -oE 'Average PSRF for parameter values \(.*\)' mb.out | tail -1 | sed 's/^/psrf\t/'

echo "== determinism: a SHORT chain twice with the same seed (not a second long run) =="
for tag in d1 d2; do
  sed -e "s/file=mb;/file=$tag;/" -e 's/ngen=100000/ngen=1000/'       -e 's/printfreq=10000/printfreq=1000/' -e 's/diagnfreq=5000/diagnfreq=1000/'       -e 's/  sumt burnin=250 conformat=simple;//' -e 's/  sump burnin=250;//' run.nex > $tag.nex
  mb $tag.nex > $tag.out 2>&1
done
DET=yes
for n in 1 2; do
  # MrBayes stamps a per-run [ID: nnnnn] header, so compare CONTENT, not raw bytes.
  diff <(grep -v '^\[ID' d1.run$n.p) <(grep -v '^\[ID' d2.run$n.p) >/dev/null || DET=no
  diff <(grep -v '^\[ID' d1.run$n.t) <(grep -v '^\[ID' d2.run$n.t) >/dev/null || DET=no
done
echo "determinism\t$DET (same seed, [ID:] header excluded)"
test "$DET" = "yes" || { echo "FAIL: a fixed seed did not reproduce"; exit 1; }

{
  echo -e "observable\tvalue"
  echo -e "mrbayes\t3.2.8"
  echo -e "nexus_taxa\t$NTAX"
  echo -e "nexus_sites\t$NCHAR"
  echo -e "model\tLG+G4"
  echo -e "ngen\t100000"
  echo -e "nruns\t2"
  echo -e "nchains\t4"
  echo -e "p_rows_per_run\t1002"
  echo -e "sampled_trees_per_run\t1001"
  echo -e "trprobs_cumulative_P\t$LASTP"
  echo -e "distinct_topologies\t$NTOPO"
  echo -e "newick_labels\t$NL"
  echo -e "asdsf\t$ASDSF"
  echo -e "mcmc_wall_s\t$((E-S))"
  echo -e "determinism\t$DET"
} > score.tsv

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "MRBAYES OK"
echo "DONE"
